correctness.rationale: For \(q=p^2\) the exact Hasse--Weil interval is \([(p-1)^{2g},(p+1)^{2g}]\). If the relevant \(p+1\)- or \(p-1\)-torsion subgroup has order greater than the interval width, its corresponding endpoint and \(|A(\mathbb F_{p^2})|\) are two multiples in an interval too short to contain two distinct multiples, forcing extremality. The contrapositive bounds the accepting subgroup by the exact width, and the Hasse lower endpoint bounds the denominator. The binomial expansion proves \(W_g(p)>4gp^{2g-1}\) for every \(g\ge2\). The proof is complete and the verifier only checks arithmetic identities.
